en: Lift Operator
The power's back! Up you go: the Gym is at the very top of the tower.
Sorry, the lift has no power. The whole city's gone dark, and the tower with it.
Sina
There you are! You must be {player}. We've been watching the gate all morning!
text: Aici erai! Trebuie să fii {player}. Am urmărit poarta toată dimineața!

en: Dexio
Welcome to Lumiose City. We assist Professor Sycamore with his research. I'm Dexio, and this is Sina.
text: Bine ai venit în Lumiose City. Îl ajutăm pe Profesorul Sycamore cu cercetarea. Eu sunt Dexio, iar ea e Sina.

en: Sina
The professor is waiting for you at his laboratory. It's just up this avenue, on the right. You can't miss it!
text: Profesorul te așteaptă la laboratorul lui. E chiar pe bulevardul ăsta, pe dreapta. Nu poți greși!

en: Dexio
We'll go ahead and tell him you've arrived. Don't get lost among the shops, now.
text: Mergem înainte să-i spunem că ai ajuns. Nu te pierde printre magazine, ai grijă.

en: Sina
The professor's laboratory is up the avenue on the right!
text: Laboratorul profesorului e pe bulevard, pe dreapta!

en: Dexio
Lumiose is a big city. The avenues all lead back to the tower, if you ever lose your way.
text: Lumiose e un oraș mare. Toate bulevardele duc înapoi la turn, dacă te rătăcești vreodată.

en: The road beyond is closed for repairs. It will open again soon.
text: Drumul de dincolo e închis pentru reparații. Se va deschide în curând.

en: The road beyond is closed for repairs. It will open again soon.
text: Drumul de dincolo e închis pentru reparații. Se va deschide în curând.

text: Drumul spre Route 5 e închis pentru reparații. Se va deschide în curând.

en: The road beyond is closed for repairs. It will open again soon.
text: Drumul de dincolo e închis pentru reparații. Se va deschide în curând.

en: Nanette
You're the Champion? Then you have to play with me! That's the rule of the park!
Aww. Okay, you can play again tomorrow. That's the rule too.
The girl with the pink hair? She's looking for her cat. It's a very grumpy cat.
Lou
I'm guarding the park! Nobody gets past without a battle!
Okay, you can get past. But only a little bit.
My Pokémon are sleepy now. Shh.
Cerise
School's out, and we battle here every afternoon. You're new. Let's see what you've got!
Okay, that wasn't fair. You're the Champion, aren't you?
Emma used to battle us here all the time, before she started working for that funny detective.
Bastien
My Pokémon is very old and very spooky. Are you scared? You should be!
Not scared at all? Not even a little?
Emma's Espurr hates noise. It always hides when we battle too loudly.
Emma
You battled all four of them? The noise must have scared Mimi half to death. My Espurr, I mean. She's run off.
She hides somewhere small and dark when she's frightened. There are three alleys near here she likes.
Where would a frightened Espurr hide?
The alley beside the bureau
The alley beside the museum
The street by the restaurant
No, she wouldn't go that far. Somewhere close, and quiet.
{player} looked into the narrow alley beside the bureau. Two wide eyes stared back out of the dark.
{player} kept very still. After a while a small grey Pokémon crept out and sniffed {player}'s hand.
Emma
Mimi! Oh, thank you! Nobody's ever been that patient with her. Not even me.
You work with the detective, don't you? He asked me to help him. I said no, because of Mimi.
But if Mimi likes you, maybe she'll like the bureau too. Tell him Emma's coming. Both of us.
Shh! My Espurr's hiding around here somewhere, and those children won't stop battling. Can you quiet them down?
Vesper
You're following me? Bad idea. Very bad idea.
Fine! I only steal Poké Balls for someone who pays well. I've never seen her face. She wears a dark suit.
Pip
I didn't take anything! Okay, I took some things. Want to battle about it?
A lady in a suit gives us sweets for every ball we bring her. She talks funny, like a machine.
Odile
How dare you look at me like that. Do you know who I am? No? Good.
Very well. I was told the balls would go to a good cause. A scientist's cause. I see now I was a fool.
